prompt: Rendered in the style of an oil painting, this scene captures a lively rooftop gathering under a starry night sky. On the left, a woman in a blue silk dress stands holding a champagne flute, her posture relaxed as she leans against the stone parapet. Next to her sits a small black cat with bright green eyes, calmly grooming its paw on the warm tiles. In the center, a man in a tuxedo gestures animatedly with his right hand while speaking to a woman wearing a gold sequined gown who listens intently, her head tilted slightly. To the right, a waiter in a white apron hands a tray of hors d'oeuvres to a guest in a leather jacket, who reaches out eagerly to take a canapé. Behind them, a large potted palm tree sways gently in the breeze, its fronds casting soft shadows on the wall. There is no moon visible in the dark expanse above. The thick impasto brushstrokes give texture to the cobblestones and the fabric of the guests' attire, emphasizing the tactile quality of the evening air and the vibrant social energy. The composition balances the figures across the frame, creating a dynamic yet harmonious visual narrative of urban celebration.
